name: Action Charters
summary: Action Charters is a small family business run by brothers Peter and Graham Allen, who sail the catamarans Stiletto and Supercats. Day cruises stop to swim with turtles and snorkel a reef and the Carlisle Bay shipwrecks, with hotel transport, an open bar and snorkel gear included. The boats are also available for private charters.
standouts: Run by brothers Peter and Graham Allen, with over 30 years sailing experience
Small boats: Stiletto takes up to 26 people and Supercats up to 12
Transport to and from the catamarans included on cruises
Pay on board in cash or by Visa, Mastercard, American Express or Discover

contact.address: Aberfoyle, Maxwell Main Road, Christ Church, Barbados

trips.title: 5 Hour Turtle-Snorkel-Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: The operator's most popular cruise sails along the coast to swim with turtles, then stops to snorkel a coral reef and a shipwreck. The catamaran then anchors closer to shore for a Bajan buffet lunch, with time to swim or walk the beach.
highlights: Snorkel a coral reef and shipwreck
Open bar for the whole cruise
trips.checkNotes: Advertises turtle feeding. Also advertises hand feeding tropical fish. Booking page is a request form (JotForm, form.jotform.com/jsform/233464353168863); payment is taken on the boat.

trips.title: 3 Hour Turtle-Snorkel Cruise
trips.summary: A shorter morning cruise along the coast to swim with turtles and snorkel a reef and a wreck. A light snack is served and the bar is open throughout.
trips.checkNotes: Advertises turtle feeding. Booking page is a request form (JotForm); payment is taken on the boat.

trips.title: 3 Hour Sunset Cruise
trips.summary: An evening version of the 3 hour turtle and snorkel cruise, timed to catch the sunset. It runs from 3pm to 6pm.
highlights: Same route as the 3 hour turtle and snorkel cruise
trips.checkNotes: No price shown for this cruise. The site says it is the same as the 3 Hour Turtle-Snorkel day cruise except it sails in the evening, so inclusions are copied from that cruise; it may also share that cruise's USD$85 / USD$55 prices, but the site does not say so. That cruise advertises turtle feeding.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: A private cruise on Stiletto or Supercats, planned around the group, for families, couples, birthdays, anniversaries and corporate events. Guests staying on the west coast can be collected from the beach in front of their hotel or guesthouse.
highlights: Minimum 3 hours, or 5 hours for a lunch or dinner cruise
Beach pickup in front of west coast hotels
trips.duration: Your choice (minimum 3 hours) 5 hours for a dinner or lunch cruise
trips.checkNotes: No private charter prices on the site. Weather and sea conditions permitting.
